name: cache-keepalive
description: Keep Claude Code's prompt cache warm across idle pauses by injecting cheap keepalive turns from a Stop hook. Saves money on API-billed sessions with normal thinking gaps; disable it on request-quota subscriptions.

interval_seconds.title: Keepalive interval (seconds)
interval_seconds.description: Seconds the Stop hook sleeps before injecting a keepalive ping. The cache TTL is 300s (5 min); 240 leaves a 60s safety margin.

keepalive_message.title: Keepalive message
keepalive_message.description: Text injected as a user-side keepalive turn. Keep it bland so Claude replies cheaply without starting tools or long output.
keepalive_message.default: got it, i need some time to think about the next move

max_loops_per_turn.title: Max keepalive loops per turn
max_loops_per_turn.description: Max consecutive keepalive cycles per idle turn before giving up. interval=240 and max=15 keeps the cache warm for ~60 minutes.
